strings.zh: ５０连胜以上{NEWLINE}达成,{SCROLL}授予参加的精灵{NEWLINE}缎带！
strings.en: For achieving a streak{NEWLINE}of 50 wins or more,{SCROLL}your Pokémon will receive a Ribbon!

strings.zh: 正如您所见,战斗前线{NEWLINE}是个非常好的地方,{SCROLL}不过！{SCROLL}除了城都以外的地方{NEWLINE}似乎也有类似的设施。
strings.en: As you can see, Battle Frontier is a{NEWLINE}great facility.{SCROLL}You know what?{SCROLL}Apparently, similar facilities are{NEWLINE}available outside of Johto.

strings.zh: 辛苦了！由我来{NEWLINE}恢复精灵的体力⋯⋯{CLEAR}哎呀,不行！{SCROLL}今天我不是来工作,{NEWLINE}是来办点私事的。
strings.en: You must be tired! Let me restore your{NEWLINE}Pokémon to full health... Oh, wait, no!{SCROLL}I’m not here to work today. I’m here on{NEWLINE}some personal business.
strings.notes: US 0096/75 | RV043: meaning: stale US; she came on personal business, not to enjoy herself; restored 'Oh, wait, no'

strings.zh: 我？{NEWLINE}我可是已经出道了的偶像哦。{SCROLL}不过工作还不是很多,{NEWLINE}所以有空的时候,{CLEAR}就来这里玩玩了⋯⋯
strings.en: Me?{SCROLL}I’m an Idol who’s already made my{NEWLINE}debut, you know!{SCROLL}But I don’t get much work yet, so{NEWLINE}whenever I have free time, I come here{CLEAR}to have some fun...
strings.notes: US 0096/76 | RV043: addition: US 'to battle Pokémon' not in zh; restored 'already debuted' and 'have fun'

strings.zh: 经过无数磨练的它们{NEWLINE}应该能５０连胜的⋯⋯{CLEAR}的吧？皮卡丘？
strings.en: They’ve been through countless rounds{NEWLINE}of training, so they should be able to{CLEAR}get a 50-win streak...{SCROLL}Right? Right, Pikachu?
strings.notes: US 0096/77; modernised from US 0096#77 | RV043: meaning: zh 它们 (they), trained through countless trials; US 'my little guy/He'

strings.en: Pikachu: ...

strings.zh: 大叔我啊,{NEWLINE}从小就超喜欢{CLEAR}这种透明的电梯了。{SCROLL}啊,骗人的骗人的！{SCROLL}大叔小时候{NEWLINE}怎么可能会有{CLEAR}这么帅气的电梯呢？
strings.en: Ever since I was a kid, this old guy has{NEWLINE}loved see-through elevators like this.{SCROLL}Ha, just kidding, just kidding!{SCROLL}How could there have been an elevator{NEWLINE}this cool back when I was a kid?
strings.notes: US 0096/79 | RV043: voice: restored 大叔 self-reference, 'cool' and the rhetorical question

strings.zh: 嘿嘿嘿！{NEWLINE}周围的人似乎都很弱！{SCROLL}⋯⋯你要这么想的话{NEWLINE}就会大意失荆州了,{CLEAR}一定要小心啊！皮卡丘！
strings.en: Heh heh heh! Everyone around here{NEWLINE}seems so weak!{SCROLL}...If you think like that, you’ll get{NEWLINE}careless and lose it all, so be really{CLEAR}careful, Pikachu!
strings.notes: US 0096/80; modernised from US 0096#80 | RV043: meaning: zh says 'weak', not 'pathetic'; 大意失荆州 is losing through carelessness

strings.zh: 皮卡丘『Pika——chu！！
strings.en: Pikachu: Pika-chu!!

strings.zh: 恭喜！{NEWLINE}５０连胜以上达成,{CLEAR}作为奖励授予参加的精灵{CLEAR}缎带！
strings.en: Congratulations! For achieving a{NEWLINE}streak of 50 wins or more, your{CLEAR}Pokémon will receive a Ribbon!

strings.zh: 恭喜！{NEWLINE}您升到了等级{VAR:0132:0}。{CLEAR}作为纪念授予参加的精灵{CLEAR}缎带！
strings.en: Congratulations! You’ve reached{NEWLINE}Rank {VAR:0132:0}. To commemorate it, your{CLEAR}Pokémon will receive a Ribbon!

strings.zh: 恭喜！{NEWLINE}您战胜了塔主,{CLEAR}作为纪念授予参加的精灵{CLEAR}缎带！
strings.en: Congratulations! You defeated the{NEWLINE}Tower Tycoon. To commemorate it,{CLEAR}your Pokémon will receive a Ribbon!

strings.zh: 恭喜！{SCROLL}为表彰这胜利{NEWLINE}送您纪念印章！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Congratulations!{SCROLL}In honor of your victory, we present{NEWLINE}you with a commemorative print!{SCROLL}
strings.notes: 纪念印章 → commemorative print; 金/银印章 → Gold/Silver Print on the Vs. Recorder.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}在{NEWLINE}战斗记录器上贴上了{CLEAR}金印章！{SCROLL}
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0} put the Gold Print{NEWLINE}on the Vs. Recorder!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}在{NEWLINE}战斗记录器上贴上了{CLEAR}银印章！{SCROLL}
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0} put the Silver{NEWLINE}Print on the Vs. Recorder!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 恭喜！{NEWLINE}{VAR:0134:0}连胜达成,{CLEAR}特此奖励{CLEAR}纪念奖杯！{SCROLL}这个我们会送到{NEWLINE}您府上的！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Congratulations on achieving your{NEWLINE}{VAR:0134:0}-win streak!{SCROLL}We present you with a{NEWLINE}commemorative trophy!{SCROLL}We’ll send it to your home!{SCROLL}
strings.notes: US 0096/88 | RV043: addition: dropped US 'for your fantastic achievement'

strings.zh: ⋯⋯哎呀,东西{NEWLINE}看来放满了啊⋯⋯{SCROLL}很抱歉,请您整理一下后{NEWLINE}再来吧！
strings.en: ...Oh dear, it looks like{NEWLINE}there’s no more room...{SCROLL}I’m very sorry. Please make{NEWLINE}some space and come back!

strings.zh: 和朋友一样选择了{NEWLINE}{VAR:0100:0}或{CLEAR}{VAR:0100:1}！{SCROLL}请和朋友商量后{NEWLINE}再来吧。
strings.en: Both Trainers have chosen {VAR:0100:0}{NEWLINE}or {VAR:0100:1}.{SCROLL}Please confer with the other Trainer{NEWLINE}and choose different Pokémon.
